name: Model call answers for the tier
purpose: A question asked at a tier gets an answer from the model that tier names.
record: Cases passed over written tier and prompt pairs against a fake provider.
disadvantages: Checks that an answer came back, not that it is any good.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=a fake arm satisfies the Protocol] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the tier asked is the tier answered and the spend is approved]

name: Provider failover and vendor answers
purpose: A call is still answered when the primary provider fails, and each vendor arm answers exact-answer maths problems.
record: Failover cases passed offline; vendor cases passed with tokens priced at the cheapest model of each vendor. Model cases passed on AIME 2025 (model_quality_aime), priced from tier_prices.csv or counted in calls on a subscription.
disadvantages: Vendor arms are not ranked: 50 problems and one prompt leave wide intervals.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=a fake arm satisfies the Protocol] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the tier asked is the tier answered and the spend is approved]
command: esoi run provider_failover --impl multi_provider; esoi run call_a_model --impl gemini; esoi run call_a_model --impl openai; esoi run call_a_model --impl deepseek; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl claude_haiku; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl claude_sonnet; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl claude_opus; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl gemini_2_5_flash_lite; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl gemini_2_5_flash; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl gpt_5_nano; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl gpt_5_mini; esoi run model_quality_aime --impl deepseek_flash
